Start with the shocking stat about earnings and followers, then pivot to the psychological impact. Your unique angle as a teen in the AI age: 'As a teen growing up in the age of AI, I can attest to the unrealistic guidelines these AI personas enforce. I believe I can portray the shift in teen identity.' Structure your pitch with: 1) Compelling headline as subject line, 2) 2-3 sentence summary highlighting the identity angle, 3) Your credentials - mention your background in AI ethics and tech to show you understand both the technical creation process AND its social impacts. Make it personal: 'With a background in tech, I am able to witness the process behind AI generation and its possible social impacts, and also its relevance in modern culture.' For your hackathon, assign your VP to reach out to the mayor for prize sponsorship while you focus on opening signups. Give them a specific script and deadline: 'Contact mayor's office by Wednesday about sponsoring $50 gift cards.' For your publication, your new VP from India needs concrete assignments TODAY. Give them three specific tasks: 1) Reach out to 5 businesses for interviews this week, 2) Write one article by Sunday, 3) Create a Medium account and cross-post existing content. For TikTok, create a rotation schedule - you post Monday/Wednesday/Friday, VP posts Tuesday/Thursday, outreach director posts weekends. The key is specificity: not 'help with publicity' but 'email these 10 organizations with this template by this date.' Set up weekly check-ins where they report progress. If someone doesn't deliver, address it directly: 'I need this done by X or we need to discuss your role.' Your 10K views proves your vision works - now multiply yourself through delegation. Start with one task per person THIS WEEK. Medium gives you access to their built-in audience, while Substack builds an email list of subscribers. Post every article on all three platforms. Media mentions - pitch your work to larger outlets. Write an opinion piece for your local paper or Teen Vogue about why documenting these businesses matters. One feature article in a major outlet can drive thousands to your site. Set specific targets: 10 businesses documented by August, 500 website visitors by September, 1 media mention by October, 100 Substack subscribers by November. Track weekly: How many new readers? Any shares or mentions? Which articles perform best? Your impact isn't just articles written - it's lives touched by those stories.
